note: The four choices that define 'X% of government is agentic'. These are Mutabaa's proposal, not a published standard. Each level has a rationale so a reviewer can argue with it.

unit.services: Count each service equally. Easy to publish, hides volume.
unit.transactions: Weight by annual transactions. Reflects what citizens experience, needs volume data.
unit.entities: Count entities where at least half of items qualify. Reflects organisational adoption.
unit.sectors: As entities, grouped by sector. Reflects policy domains.

scope.citizen-services: Citizen-facing services only. The narrowest, most visible reading.
scope.services-and-operations: Services plus back-office operations. The broadest reading, as in 'sectors, services and operations'.

threshold.2: Assists: AI suggests, a person decides.
threshold.3: Acts with approval: AI executes steps, a person approves outcomes.
threshold.4: Acts autonomously within limits, with monitoring.

guardrails.required: Also requires human oversight, an audit trail, UAE data residency and a fallback path.

mapping_status: Not yet mapped to a published framework or reviewed by a practitioner. Tracked as an open item in docs/reviews/03-tii.md.
